name: Stuttgart Airport

runway.v: one runway, 3,345 m long and 45 m wide

curfew.v: night restriction: no departures 23:00-06:00 and no arrivals 23:30-06:00 local; delayed landings allowed until midnight if scheduled before 23:30; flights with special permission from the aviation authority, emergency and diverted flights, and certain propeller aircraft are permitted

handling.v: general aviation handling partner at the General Aviation Terminal: Kurz Aviation Service (the page does not say it is mandatory)
handling.quote: an experienced handling partner for general aviation in Stuttgart
